items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) / StyleSmuggler
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected systems. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An authentication bypass flaw in Adobe Commerce that allows high-privileged attackers to circumvent security controls and gain unauthorized write access to protected resources.

items.title: Authorization Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An authorization bypass flaw in Adobe Commerce that allows unauthenticated attackers to circumvent security controls and gain unauthorized read access to sensitive data.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Customer Session Takeover)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. This vulnerability has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Stored XSS Vulnerability
items.summary: A stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allowing low-privileged attackers to inject malicious scripts into form fields, potentially leading to session hijacking or unauthorized actions.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that could result in a security feature bypass, allowing an attacker with high privileges to gain unauthorized write access.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Privilege Escalation)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.
